title: 第23章
content:
“天哪！这家伙是驴子么？”下一刻，苏瑶睁大双眼，惊讶的合不拢嘴。“看上去斯斯文文的，没想到本钱这么雄厚，今后哪个姑娘受得了啊？！”苏瑶惊讶的同时，又难免拿陈青云和自己的老公戴斌作比较。两者完全不是一个级别的，简直是小乌见大乌。“这混蛋，刚才竟敢在我身上乱摸，那我也摸回来……”苏瑶也不急着拍照，反而伸出双手，去摸陈青云轮廓分明的腹肌。她毕竟是个正常的女人，对高大帅气的异性也有着幻想。“这女人，真够浪的！”陈青云心中暗骂了一声，被她的玉手来回撩拨，愈发亢奋起来。苏瑶也发现了这一点，她又想到陈青云差点成为自己的妹夫，现在却一丝不挂躺在面前，这让她感受到一种难以言喻的刺激。“反正他昏迷了，那不如……”苏瑶心中生出了一个大胆的念头。现在陈青云已经“昏迷”了，无论她做什么疯狂的事情，都没人知道。下一刻，她竟然直接爬到了陈青云的身上……“靠！她是把我当成玩具了么？”陈青云半眯着眼，悄悄打量着近在咫尺的苏瑶。只见她满面潮红，媚眼含春，犹如一朵盛开的花蕊，等待采撷。那具完美的娇躯，也毫无遮挡，让他一饱眼福。只可惜苏瑶忙活了大半天，急的香汗淋漓，双腿发软，却都没能成功。“混蛋，我都没力气了，你倒是给点力啊……”苏瑶气得扭了一下陈青云的胳膊，那娇媚的嗓音，如同猫儿喊春。就在这时，她只觉得一只大手，突然握住了自己的腰。“怎么回事？”苏瑶大惊失色，低头一看，却发现陈青云竟然睁开了眼，一脸坏笑的望着她。“嫂子，没想到你这么要！既然你没力气了，那接下来就换我来吧！”陈青云直接起身，将苏瑶摁在了大床上，双手握住她纤细的小蛮腰，随时准备冲锋。“啊……快住手！”苏瑶这才反应过来，尖叫连连，拼命挣扎。“啪！”陈青云也不客气，一巴掌拍在她的翘臀上，呵斥道：“老实点，否则别怪我不客气了！”苏瑶吃痛之下，又羞又怒：“你……你竟敢打我那儿？王八蛋，信不信我去告你！”

“哼！”陈青云却一声冷笑，咬住了她的耳垂，警告起来。“好啊，你去告我啊！”“但别怪我没提醒，你和戴斌的阴谋早就被我识破，甚至被我录音！”“你们夫妻合谋陷害我，如果真的闹大，可是要坐牢的！”……听到这话，苏瑶一下子慌了，脸色惨白。她自知理亏，被捏住了把柄，再加上陈青云有新县长当靠山，想要收拾她易如反掌。“陈青云，对不起，是我和戴斌错了，求求你大人有大量，放我们一马吧？”苏瑶的眸中噙着泪花，丰腴的身子轻轻颤抖。她非常会利用自己的美貌，只要装出楚楚可怜的样子，就能博取异性的同情，不忍心惩罚她。只不过，陈青云之前听到了她和戴斌的对话，知道这对夫妻要往死里整自己！“别在那儿装可怜了！如果道歉有用，还要警察干嘛？”陈青云语气冰冷。“到底要怎么做，你才肯高抬贵手？”苏瑶强忍着委屈问道。“呵呵！”陈青云上下打量着她的娇躯，戏谑一笑：“嫂子，你不是想用美人计么，那就继续吧！如果让我满意了，就不计较之前的事情了！”“这怎么行？我可是有老公的……”苏瑶察觉到他火辣的目光，娇羞的扭过头，根本不敢与他对视。“嫂子，我比戴斌更年轻，更帅气，甚至更有劲……难道你就不想试试么？”陈青云说话的同时，朝她扑了过去，疯狂的吻向她美艳的脸蛋儿。“哎呀……你坏死了！”苏瑶被吻的气喘吁吁，虽然还在用手推他，但明显是半推半就，欲拒还迎。“嫂子，你的身子真润！”陈青云贪婪无比，不放过她身上每一寸肌肤，心中愈发激动起来。要知道，他和苏妍儿谈了一年多恋爱，也只是搂搂抱抱。苏妍儿一直找借口，说要等结婚后才能干那事，害得他憋了那么久。现在，苏妍儿的亲姐姐苏瑶，却像是个乖巧的小妻子，任由他为所欲为！“嫂子，春宵一刻值千金！戴斌随时都有可能回来，我们还是快点吧！”说着，陈青云将苏瑶摁在大床上，自己站在后面，正要发起进攻……“叮铃铃！”就在这时，苏瑶的手机响了，来电显示“妹妹”。

"Oh my god! Is this guy a donkey?" The next moment, Su Yao opened her eyes wide and closed her mouth in surprise."Looks polite, but I didn't expect that the capital is so strong. Which girl can bear it in the future?!" Su Yao was surprised and could not help but compare Chen Qingyun with her husband Dai Bin.The two are not at the same level at all."This bastard dared to touch me just now, so I'll touch him back..." Su Yao was not in a hurry to take pictures, but stretched out her hands to touch Chen Qingyun's well-defined abdominal muscles.After all, she is a normal woman, and she also has fantasies about tall and handsome men of the opposite sex."This woman is so slutty!" Chen Qingyun cursed in his heart, becoming more and more excited as her delicate hands teased her back and forth.Su Yao also discovered this, and she thought that Chen Qingyun almost became her brother-in-law, but now he was lying naked in front of her, which made her feel an indescribable excitement."Anyway, he's in a coma, so why not..." Su Yao had a bold idea in her heart.Now that Chen Qingyun is "coma", no matter what crazy things she does, no one knows.The next moment, she climbed directly onto Chen Qingyun... "Damn! Does she treat me as a toy?" Chen Qingyun half-squinted and quietly looked at Su Yao, who was close at hand.Her face was flushed and her eyes were full of spring, just like a blooming stamen, waiting to be picked.That perfect body was completely unobstructed, allowing him to feast his eyes on it.It's a pity that Su Yao worked hard for a long time, sweating profusely and her legs were weak, but she still couldn't succeed."Asshole, I don't have any strength, please give me some strength..." Su Yao was so angry that she twisted Chen Qingyun's arm, her charming voice was like a cat calling for spring.At this moment, she felt a big hand suddenly hold her waist."What's going on?" Su Yao was shocked. She looked down and found that Chen Qingyun had opened her eyes and looked at her with a wicked smile."Sister-in-law, I didn't expect you to want it so much! Since you have no strength, let me do it next!" Chen Qingyun stood up directly, pressed Su Yao on the big bed, held her slender waist with both hands, and was ready to charge at any time."Ah... stop it!" Su Yao finally reacted, screaming and struggling desperately."Pa!" Chen Qingyun was not polite, slapped her on the buttocks, and scolded: "Be honest, otherwise don't blame me for being rude!" Su Yao felt ashamed and angry in pain: "You... how dare you hit me there? Bastard, believe it or not, I will sue you!"

"Hmph!" Chen Qingyun sneered, bit her earlobe, and warned."Okay, you go and sue me!" "But don't blame me for not reminding you. I have seen through your and Dai Bin's conspiracy a long time ago, and I even recorded it!" "You and your wife conspired to frame me. If it really gets bigger, you will go to jail!"... Hearing this, Su Yao suddenly panicked and turned pale.She knew she was in the wrong and had been taken advantage of. In addition, Chen Qingyun had a new county magistrate as his backer, so it would be easy to deal with her."Chen Qingyun, I'm sorry, it was Dai Bin and I who made the mistake. Please let me go, sir?" Su Yao had tears in her eyes, and her plump body trembled slightly.She is very good at using her beauty. As long as she pretends to be pitiful, she can win the sympathy of the opposite sex and cannot bear to punish her.However, Chen Qingyun had heard the conversation between her and Dai Bin before, and knew that the couple was going to kill themselves!"Stop pretending to be pitiful there! If apologizing is helpful, why do we need the police?" Chen Qingyun's tone was cold."What should I do before you are willing to show your favor?" Su Yao asked, holding back her grievance."Haha!" Chen Qingyun looked up and down her delicate body and smiled jokingly: "Sister-in-law, don't you want to use a beauty trick? Then go ahead! If you satisfy me, you won't care about what happened before!" "How can this be done? I have a husband..." Su Yao noticed his hot gaze and turned her head shyly, not daring to look at him at all."Sister-in-law, I'm younger, more handsome, and even more energetic than Dai Bin...don't you want to give it a try?" As Chen Qingyun spoke, he rushed towards her and kissed her charming face crazily."Oh... you're so bad!" Su Yao was panting after being kissed. Although she was still pushing him with her hands, she was obviously half-pushing him and trying to refuse him."Sister-in-law, your body is so moist!" Chen Qingyun was so greedy that he didn't let go of every inch of her body, and he became more and more excited.You know, he and Su Yan'er have been in love for more than a year, and they just cuddled.Su Yan'er kept making excuses, saying she had to wait until she got married before she could do that, which made him hold back for so long.Now, Su Yan'er's biological sister Su Yao is like a well-behaved little wife, letting him do whatever he wants!"Sister-in-law, a spring night is worth a thousand pieces of gold! Dai Bin may come back at any time, let's hurry up!" With that, Chen Qingyun pressed Su Yao on the big bed and stood behind him, about to launch an attack... "Ding, ding, ding, ding, ding, ding!" Just then, Su Yao's cell phone rang, with the caller ID "Sister".
